## - with INTERVAL operands and results
# Sources: BigQuery's operators reference (datetime subtraction and interval arithmetic
# operators); GoogleSQL's compliance/functions_testlib_interval.cc (interval, date, datetime and
# timestamp subtractions, NULLs and overflow).

SELECT DATE '2021-05-20' - DATE '2020-04-19'
=> "0-0 396 0:0:0"

SELECT DATE '1900-12-31' - DATE '1900-01-01'
=> "0-0 364 0:0:0"

SELECT DATE '0001-01-01' - DATE '9999-12-31'
=> "0-0 -3652058 0:0:0"

SELECT DATE '1970-01-01' - CAST(NULL AS DATE)
=> null

# DATETIME differences have days and time.
SELECT DATETIME '2000-01-01 00:00:00' - DATETIME '1900-01-01 00:00:00'
=> "0-0 36524 0:0:0"

SELECT DATETIME '1900-01-02 00:00:00' - DATETIME '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000001'
=> "0-0 0 23:59:59.999999"

SELECT DATETIME '0001-01-01 00:00:00' - DATETIME '9999-12-31 23:59:59.999999'
=> "0-0 -3652058 -23:59:59.999999"

SELECT CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) - DATETIME '1970-01-01 22:22:22'
=> null

# TIMESTAMP differences have only time.
SELECT TIMESTAMP '2021-06-01 12:34:56.789' - TIMESTAMP '2021-05-31 00:00:00'
=> "0-0 0 36:34:56.789"

SELECT TIMESTAMP '1900-01-02 00:00:00+00' - TIMESTAMP '1900-01-01 23:59:59.999999+00'
=> "0-0 0 0:0:0.000001"

SELECT TIMESTAMP '0001-01-01 00:00:00+00' - TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59.999999+00'
=> "0-0 0 -87649415:59:59.999999"

SELECT TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 10:20:30+00' - CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP)
=> null

SELECT CAST(DATE '2021-04-20' - INTERVAL 25 HOUR AS STRING)
=> "2021-04-18 23:00:00"

SELECT CAST(DATETIME '2000-03-31 00:00:00' - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS STRING)
=> "2000-02-29 00:00:00"

SELECT CAST(DATETIME '2000-02-29 00:00:00' - INTERVAL 1 YEAR AS STRING)
=> "1999-02-28 00:00:00"

SELECT CAST(DATETIME '2000-01-01 00:00:00' - INTERVAL '1-2 3 4:5:6' YEAR TO SECOND AS STRING)
=> "1998-10-28 19:54:54"

SELECT CAST(DATETIME '9999-12-31 23:59:59.999999' - INTERVAL '87649415:59:59.999999' HOUR TO SECOND AS STRING)
=> "0001-01-01 00:00:00"

SELECT DATETIME '0001-01-31 00:00:00' - INTERVAL 1 MONTH
=> error:

SELECT DATETIME '9999-01-01 00:00:00' - INTERVAL -1 YEAR
=> error:

SELECT DATETIME '2000-01-01 00:00:00' - CAST(NULL AS INTERVAL)
=> null

SELECT CAST(TIMESTAMP '2021-05-02 00:01:02.345+00' - INTERVAL 10 SECOND AS STRING)
=> "2021-05-02 00:00:52.345+00"

SELECT CAST(TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' - INTERVAL '1 -24:0:0' DAY TO SECOND AS STRING)
=> "2000-01-01 00:00:00+00"

# GoogleSQL subtracts no months or years from a TIMESTAMP.
SELECT TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' - INTERVAL 1 MONTH
=> error:

SELECT TIMESTAMP '2000-01-01 00:00:00+00' - INTERVAL -1 YEAR
=> error:

SELECT CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 1 SECOND
=> null

SELECT INTERVAL '1-2 0 0:0:0' YEAR TO SECOND - INTERVAL 2 MONTH
=> "1-0 0 0:0:0"

SELECT INTERVAL '2-3 4 5:6:7' YEAR TO SECOND - INTERVAL '1-1 1 1:1:1' YEAR TO SECOND
=> "1-2 3 4:5:6"

SELECT INTERVAL '10000-0 3660000 0:0:0' YEAR TO SECOND - INTERVAL 3660000 DAY
=> "10000-0 0 0:0:0"

SELECT INTERVAL -10000 YEAR - INTERVAL 1 MONTH
=> error:

SELECT INTERVAL -3660000 DAY - INTERVAL 1 DAY
=> error:

SELECT INTERVAL 1 YEAR - CAST(NULL AS INTERVAL)
=> null
